tip.label: Tip:
tip.1: Only hit a minion when it dies: a last hit pays gold, a normal hit only costs time.
tip.2: Tab shows every player's death timer. Two enemies dead for 30 s is your window for an objective.
tip.3: Click the enemy's Flash in the scoreboard as soon as they use it: the timer tells you when you may be aggressive again.
tip.4: Clicking an objective timer at the top posts the time to your team.
tip.5: Recall right after pushing a wave: it runs into the enemy tower and you lose almost no CS.
tip.6: When an enemy vanishes, their "?" stays on the minimap for 45 s. Ping them missing (V).
tip.7: The River Leviathan stacks: at four stacks the team gets the soul.
tip.8: Kesselbrut stacks add structure damage: the team that has them should push side lanes.
tip.9: Gold efficiency in the shop: above 100 % means the stats are cheaper than the parts.
tip.10: Watch the indicator: if an ability does not stop you while walking, you can dodge during it.
tip.11: After the game the analysis shows what a Challenger would have done in your hardest moments.
tip.12: Left-click an enemy to open its target frame at the top left with health, level and crowd control.
score.sumTimerTip: Click when you saw the spell cast: starts its cooldown timer (click again to clear).

trainer.title: Trainer
trainer.mode.lastHitDesc: One lane, no enemy champion. CS, missed CS, gold per minute, grade at the end. Optional under your own tower.
trainer.mode.dodgeDesc: Skillshots and ground effects aim at you, faster and faster. How long do you last?
trainer.mode.kiteDesc: Dummy stands, walks or chases you. Attack uptime, DPS vs theory, combo time.

trainer.mode.arenaDesc: Preset level and items, small arena, rounds until someone wins.

trainer.hint.dodge: Keep moving: shots aim at you, leading your movement on higher difficulties.
trainer.hint.kite: Move between attacks (attack-move). Every ability in a row = combo, then they are refreshed.
trainer.hint.laneDuel: No jungler, no other lanes. First tower always wins.
trainer.hint.arena: No recall, no respawn until the next round. Time out: more health wins.

ultChoice.title: Choose your ultimate (1 / 2 / 3)
trainer.mode.scenarioDesc: Short scripted situations with a goal and a time limit: tower defence, gank escape, dive, dragon steal, freezing a wave, protecting the carry, Flash dodge, catching a wave under tower, Baron call, shove and recall.
trainer.hint.scenario: Reach the goal before the time runs out. Retry any time from the result window.
scenario.turret2v1.name: Survive a 2v1 at your tower
scenario.turret2v1.desc: Minute 7, you stand in front of your mid tower at half health. The enemy mid and jungler (one level higher, all-in) arrive with a minion wave.
scenario.turret2v1.goal: Survive 25 seconds – fall back under your tower and use it.
scenario.gankEscape.name: Spot the gank and escape
scenario.gankEscape.desc: Minute 6, you pushed mid far forward. The enemy mid is in front of you, the enemy jungler waits in the river bush next to you.
scenario.gankEscape.goal: Reach your own tower's range alive (25 s).
scenario.towerDive.name: Tower dive for the kill
scenario.towerDive.desc: Minute 9, the enemy mid sits under his tower with 30 % health. You are two levels higher at full health – but the tower shoots you once you attack him.
scenario.towerDive.goal: Get the kill within 20 seconds without dying.
scenario.dragonSteal.name: Steal the dragon with Smite
scenario.dragonSteal.desc: Minute 10, the enemy team is hitting the Leviathan, it is down to half health. You arrive from the river as jungler with Smite.
scenario.dragonSteal.goal: Land the last hit on the Leviathan (Smite once its health drops below Smite damage).
scenario.freezeWave.name: Freeze the wave
scenario.freezeWave.desc: Minute 5, a big enemy wave pushes towards you, your own wave is small. No enemy champion.
scenario.freezeWave.goal: Hold the wave in front of your tower for 60 s (at least 60 % of the time, never at the tower) and get at least 6 CS.
scenario.protectCarry.name: Teamfight: protect the carry
scenario.protectCarry.desc: Minute 12 mid: you play support for your marksman (85 % health). Two all-in enemies dive him.
scenario.protectCarry.goal: Your marksman survives 20 seconds – or both enemies fall.
scenario.flashUlt.name: Flash-dodge an ultimate
scenario.flashUlt.desc: An enemy marksman fires five wide, fast ultimates at you – too wide to walk out of. Flash is back before every shot.
scenario.flashUlt.goal: Dodge at least 4 of 5 shots (Flash sideways out of the path).
scenario.why.trade: Kill secured – but you died too.
scenario.why.lostDragon: The enemy team took the Leviathan.
scenario.why.pushed: The wave did not stay in front of your tower.
scenario.waveCatch.name: Catch the wave under tower (gank danger)
scenario.waveCatch.desc: Minute 8: a big enemy wave (two waves) crashes into your mid tower and you have no wave of your own. The enemy jungler is visible on the minimap, one jump away. Every CS under the tower is safe gold - but only if you stay alive.
scenario.waveCatch.goal: Get at least 4 CS from the wave and survive. Stay inside tower range while the jungler is close (score: CS against risk).
scenario.waveCatch.tip: A Challenger checks the minimap after every last hit, stays inside tower range and lets the tower do the damage work. He only gives up CS when the jungler gets closer than he can retreat from.
scenario.baronCall.name: Baron call with a lead (Schleierwaechter)
scenario.baronCall.desc: Minute 22: your team is about 4000 gold ahead, the enemy jungler is dead (the respawn timer is in the panel), two enemies are still in their lanes. The Schleierwaechter is up. You and two allies attack it.
scenario.baronCall.goal: Kill the Schleierwaechter without dying yourself before an enemy steals it. The faster and the fewer deaths on your team, the higher the score.
scenario.baronCall.tip: A Challenger only starts the Schleierwaechter with the jungler's death timer in his favour: he checks how many enemies are close and when the jungler returns, and stops when a steal threatens or an enemy cuts off the retreat.
scenario.shoveRecall.name: Shove-and-recall timing
scenario.shoveRecall.desc: Minute 8: you carry 1800 gold for new items. Your wave meets the enemy wave in the middle. Shove the wave into the enemy tower, step out of range and recall.
scenario.shoveRecall.goal: Recall only when the enemy wave (at most 1 minion) is nearly dead and lose at most 2 of your own minions. The recall must not be interrupted.
scenario.shoveRecall.tip: A Challenger clears the enemy wave fast with abilities, waits until his minions reach the tower, walks out of tower and enemy range at once and starts the recall there - so he loses few minions and returns to a full wave.
scenario.why.caught: Wave caught: enough CS and always near the tower.
scenario.why.caughtRisky: CS secured, survived - but too long without cover while the jungler was in range.
scenario.why.passive: Too little CS: you left the wave to the tower (at least 4 needed).
scenario.why.baronClean: Schleierwaechter down, nobody on your team died.
scenario.why.baronCost: Schleierwaechter down, but allies died on the way.
scenario.why.baronStolen: The enemy team stole the Schleierwaechter.
scenario.why.shoved: Clean shove and recall: at most 2 minions lost.
scenario.why.early: Recalled too early: the enemy wave was still alive or your wave was too small.
scenario.why.lostMinions: Too many minions lost: the tower tore your wave apart during the recall.
scenario.why.noRecall: You did not use the time for the recall.
ghost.title: What a Challenger would have done
ghost.about: Challenger ghost: a Challenger bot decided along the whole game with exactly your view (same fog, no extra info) without acting. These are the moments where it would have played most differently – with its reason.
ghost.none: No big differences – the Challenger ghost would have decided much like you.
ghost.sub: The {n} most important moments where the Challenger ghost would have decided differently.
ghost.sub1: The moment where the Challenger ghost would have decided most differently.
ghost.retreat.ghost: Would have backed off at once, towards the own tower.
ghost.recall.ghost: Would have backed off and recalled.
ghost.lastHit.ghost: Would have last-hit these {n} minions (≈ {gold} gold).
ghost.objective.ghost: Would have gone to the {obj} to take or defend it.
ghost.allin.situation: Enemy at only {hp} % health in range.
ghost.allin.ghost: Would have gone all-in for the kill.
ghost.out.objLost: Were far away – the enemy took the {obj}.
ghost.out.escaped: Did not follow up, the enemy escaped.
ghost.reason.lowHp: Too little health for this situation.
ghost.reason.towerAggro: The enemy tower was targeting you.
ghost.reason.outnumbered: Outnumbered – more enemies than allies nearby.
ghost.reason.flashSafe: The safe spot was no longer reachable on foot in time.
ghost.reason.wonSkirmish: Fight won – convert the lead into an objective.
ghost.reason.objective: The objective was safe enough (vision, numbers, Smite).
ghost.reason.lastHit: Minion was in the last-hit window.

recap.hint.tower: A Challenger does not fight under the enemy tower unless an own minion draws the tower shot.
recap.hint.group: A Challenger would have recalled earlier with several enemies in range - and would not have pushed with enemies missing on the map.
recap.hint.minions: A Challenger does not walk into enemy minion waves without controlling the minion aggro first.
recap.hint.monster: A Challenger only fights monsters at full health with the right abilities.
recap.hint.burst: The damage came in under 2 s: a Challenger keeps an escape or a dash ready before entering range.
recap.hint.magic: Mostly magic damage: a Challenger would have bought magic resist early.
recap.hint.phys: Mostly physical damage: a Challenger would have bought armor early.
recap.hint.default: A Challenger would have kept distance to the killer and checked the minimap for positions.

menu.tutorialDesc: Step by step: moving, abilities, last hits, shop, wards, recall, towers.
tutorial.label: Tutorial
tutorial.finishText: You know the basics now. Keep practicing in the trainer or start a match against bots.
tutorial.step.move.title: Move
tutorial.step.move.text: Right-click on the ground. Your champion walks there.
tutorial.step.move.tip: Walk a good distance. A click right next to your feet is not enough.
tutorial.step.attackMove.title: Attack-move
tutorial.step.attackMove.text: Press {attackMove} and click on the ground. Your champion walks and attacks enemies on the way.
tutorial.step.levelUp.title: Learn an ability
tutorial.step.levelUp.text: You have skill points. Click the + above an ability to learn it.
tutorial.step.levelUp.tip: The + only shows above abilities you can learn right now.
tutorial.step.cast.title: Use abilities
tutorial.step.cast.text: A practice dummy stands in front of you, abilities cost no mana. Cast Q, W, E and R ({q}, {w}, {e}, {r}) once each.
tutorial.step.cast.tip: Point the mouse at the dummy and press the key. The counter shows how many abilities you have used.
tutorial.step.shop.title: Shop
tutorial.step.shop.text: You have 1500 gold. Press {shop}, open the shop and buy an item.
tutorial.step.shop.tip: Pick an item and confirm the purchase. A cheap potion is enough.
tutorial.step.ward.title: Place a ward
tutorial.step.ward.text: Press {trinket} and click a spot in range. A ward appears there and gives you vision.
tutorial.step.ward.tip: The trinket has charges. Placing a ward uses one.
tutorial.step.recall.title: Recall
tutorial.step.recall.text: Press {recall} and stand still until the bar runs out. Then you are in the fountain.
tutorial.step.recall.tip: Moving or taking damage interrupts the recall. Press {recall} again.
tutorial.step.lastHit.title: Last hits
tutorial.step.lastHit.text: Enemy minions are coming. Land the final blow when they are almost dead: 5 minions.
tutorial.step.lastHit.tip: Wait until the minion health bar is nearly empty, then attack. That earns gold.
tutorial.step.tower.title: Destroy a tower
tutorial.step.tower.text: Follow your minions to the enemy tower and destroy it. While minions are near, the tower targets them.
tutorial.step.tower.tip: Stay close to your minions and attack the tower while they keep it busy.
tutorial.step.summoners.title: Summoner spells
tutorial.step.summoners.text: Use a summoner spell with {d} or {f}. They have a long cooldown.
tutorial.step.summoners.tip: The two spells sit to the right of your abilities. Hover them for details.
